    @pytest.mark.priority(6)
    def test_ar_report_lists_insurance_claim(self):
        """Navigate to AR Report and verify the recently submitted Medicare claim
        is reflected in the Insurance row with a non-zero amount."""
        self.dsme_claims.navigate_to_ar_report()
        assert "ar-report" in self.dsme_claims.page.url, \
            f"Expected to be on AR Report page, got: {self.dsme_claims.page.url}"
        row_data = self.dsme_claims.get_ar_insurance_row_data()
        assert row_data, "Insurance row not found in AR Report."
        assert row_data.get("type") == "Insurance", \
            f"Expected row type 'Insurance', got: {row_data.get('type')}"
        # At least one monetary column should be non-zero (our Medicare claim contributes)
        monetary = [row_data.get(k, "$0") for k in ("draft_charges", "current", "aging_ar")]
